scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

benefits_summary: Cashless and paperless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year at empanelled hospitals, portable across India.

eligibility_criteria.bpl_or_secc_required: SECC 2011 or another officially notified category

required_documents: Ration card or family record where applicable

chunks: AB-PMJAY provides cashless cover up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year.
